source_title: 5 Bengaluru residents, including police inspector and lawyers, killed in Uttarakhand chopper crash - The Times of India
source_excerpt: BENGALURU: Five Bengaluru residents, including a police inspector and four others, have died when a helicopter crashed near Joshimath in Uttarakhand on Friday.The pilot, Himanshu, was also killed in the crash.The deceased passengers have been identified as police inspector Arun Salunke, HS Nataraj, K Sudheer, Shankar Gowda and Pratap. Most of them were advocates, according to the information available.The bodies have been found but not yet recovered, said Chamoli Superintendent of Police Surjit Singh Panwar, news agency PTI reported.Sources said the five had reached Uttarakhand on Wednesday and boarded the helicopter on Friday morning. The crash occurred near Joshimath, around 2.21pm, officials said.The helicopter, operated by Trans Bharat Aviation Pvt Ltd, was flying from Badrinath to Sahastradhara in Dehradun, PTI reported.It took off at around 1.14pm and lost communication while flying over the Joshimath valley, according to the Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority (UCADA).The chopper crashed into a hillside near JP Power House, close to Marwari Bridge.Teams from the district administration, police, State Disaster Response Force, Army and Indo-Tibetan Border Police were sent to the site for rescue operations.Uttarakhand chief minister Pushkar Singh Dhami said he was monitoring the situation and had directed officials to ensure that critically injured passengers were airlifted to a higher-level medical facility.UCADA also said that the entire fleet of Trans Bharat Aviation had been grounded as a precautionary measure.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Bengaluru | Silver Rate in Bengaluru | Bank Holidays in Bengaluru | Public Holidays in Bengaluru | Bengaluru AQI | Weather in Bengaluru | Petrol Price in Bengaluru | Diesel Price in Bengaluru | CNG Price in Bengaluru | LPG Price in BengaluruStay updated with the latest Bengaluru news. अधिकारियों और समाचार रिपोर्टों के अनुसार, शुक्रवार को उत्तराखंड में जोशीमठ के पास एक हेलीकॉप्टर दुर्घटना में एक पुलिस निरीक्षक और चार अन्य सहित पांच बेंगलुरु निवासी तथा पायलट की मौत हो गई।

पीटीआई की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, चमोली के पुलिस अधीक्षक सुरजीत सिंह पंवार ने बताया कि शव मिल गए हैं लेकिन अभी उन्हें निकाला नहीं गया है। अधिकारियों द्वारा बेंगलुरु के पीड़ितों की पहचान पुलिस निरीक्षक अरुण सालुंके, एच.एस. नटराज, के. सुधीर, शंकर गौड़ा और प्रताप के रूप में की गई है। रिपोर्ट के अनुसार इनमें से अधिकांश लोग वकील थे। पायलट की पहचान हिमांशु के रूप में हुई है।

## घटना का क्रम और विवरण

* **आगमन:** सूत्रों ने बताया कि ये पांचों व्यक्ति बुधवार को उत्तराखंड पहुंचे थे।
* **उड़ान:** हेलीकॉप्टर ने शुक्रवार को दोपहर करीब 1:14 बजे बद्रीनाथ से देहरादून के सहस्त्रधारा के लिए उड़ान भरी थी।
* **संपर्क टूटना:** उत्तराखंड नागरिक उड्डयन विकास प्राधिकरण (UCADA) ने बताया कि जोशीमठ घाटी के ऊपर उड़ान भरते समय विमान का संपर्क टूट गया था।
* **दुर्घटना स्थल:** अधिकारियों ने बताया कि यह दुर्घटना दोपहर करीब 2:14 बजे मारवाड़ी पुल के पास जेपी पावर हाउस के नजदीक पहाड़ी पर हुई।

## बचाव अभियान और आधिकारिक प्रतिक्रिया

यह हेलीकॉप्टर ट्रांस भारत एविएशन प्राइवेट लिमिटेड द्वारा संचालित किया जाता था। इस घटना के बाद, यूसीएडीए (UCADA) ने एहतियाती उपाय के तौर पर ट्रांस भारत एविएशन के पूरे बेड़े को ग्राउंड कर दिया है।

दुर्घटना स्थल पर जिला प्रशासन, स्थानीय पुलिस, राज्य आपदा प्रतिक्रिया बल (SDRF), सेना और भारत-तिब्बत सीमा पुलिस (ITBP) के दलों को बचाव कार्य के लिए भेजा गया। उत्तराखंड के मुख्यमंत्री पुष्कर सिंह धामी ने कहा कि वे स्थिति पर नजर बनाए हुए हैं और अधिकारियों को निर्देश दिए हैं कि यदि कोई गंभीर रूप से घायल हो, तो उसे बेहतर चिकित्सा सुविधा के लिए एयरलिफ्ट किया जाए।

## सत्यापन और व्यावहारिक निहितार्थ

उड्डयन सुरक्षा अपडेट या आधिकारिक आपदा प्रतिक्रिया से संबंधित विवरणों को सत्यापित करने के इच्छुक पाठक उत्तराखंड नागरिक उड्डयन विकास प्राधिकरण या चमोली के स्थानीय जिला प्रशासन की आधिकारिक घोषणाओं की सहायता ले सकते हैं।

en_body:
Five residents from Bengaluru, including a police inspector and four others, alongside the pilot, died in a helicopter crash near Joshimath in Uttarakhand on Friday, according to officials and news reports.

Chamoli Superintendent of Police Surjit Singh Panwar stated that the bodies had been found but not yet recovered, as reported by PTI. The victims from Bengaluru have been identified by authorities as police inspector Arun Salunke, H.S. Nataraj, K. Sudheer, Shankar Gowda, and Pratap. Reports indicate that most of them were advocates. The pilot was identified as Himanshu.

## Incident Timeline and Details

* **Arrival:** Sources reported that the five individuals reached Uttarakhand on Wednesday.
* **Departure:** The helicopter took off at approximately 1:14 PM on Friday from Badrinath, heading toward Sahastradhara in Dehradun.
* **Communication Loss:** The Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority (UCADA) stated that the aircraft lost communication while flying over the Joshimath valley.
* **Crash Location:** Officials reported that the crash occurred at around 2:14 PM near JP Power House, close to Marwari Bridge, where the helicopter struck a hillside.

## Operations and Official Response

The helicopter was operated by Trans Bharat Aviation Pvt Ltd. Following the incident, UCADA announced that the entire fleet of Trans Bharat Aviation has been grounded as a precautionary measure.

Rescue teams from the district administration, local police, State Disaster Response Force (SDRF), the Army, and the Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP) were deployed to the crash site. Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami stated that he was monitoring the situation and directed officials to ensure that any critically injured individuals received emergency airlift support to higher-level medical facilities.

## Verification and Practical Implications

Readers seeking to verify details regarding aviation safety updates or official disaster responses can consult announcements from the Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority or local district administration briefings in Chamoli.
